title: Mi familia
summary_en: Lucía introduces her family and her two pets. One Saturday, her dad comes home with a moving box.

pic.alt: Lucía's family lines up in front of their house: parents, brother, grandfather and the dog.

sentences.fr: Me llamo Lucía y tengo ocho años.
sentences.en: My name is Lucía and I am eight years old.
This is my family.

sentences.fr: Vivimos en una casa grande con jardín.
sentences.en: We live in a big house with a garden.

sentences.fr: Mi familia es grande y simpática.
sentences.en: My family is big and friendly.
My mum is called Elena.

sentences.fr: Es doctora y le gusta cantar.
sentences.en: She is a doctor and likes to sing.
My dad is called Javier.

sentences.fr: Es alto y cocina muy bien.
sentences.en: He is tall and cooks very well.
I have a brother.

sentences.fr: Se llama Pablo y tiene cinco años.
sentences.en: He is called Pablo and is five years old.

sentences.fr: Pablo es pequeño, pero habla mucho.
sentences.en: Pablo is small, but he talks a lot.

sentences.fr: Mi hermano y el perro corren por el jardín.
sentences.en: My brother and the dog run around the garden.

sentences.fr: También vive con nosotros mi abuelo Tomás.
sentences.en: My grandfather Tomás also lives with us.

sentences.fr: El abuelo lee el periódico en el jardín.
sentences.en: Grandpa reads the newspaper in the garden.
We have two animals at home.
Toby is our dog.
He is big and brown.
Luna is our cat.
She is small and black.
The dog eats a lot.

sentences.fr: La gata duerme todo el día.
sentences.en: The cat sleeps all day.

pic.alt: The family gathers round the box and finds a small white rabbit inside.

sentences.fr: Es sábado y papá llega a casa con una caja.
sentences.en: It is Saturday and Dad arrives home with a box.
"We have a surprise!" says Mum.
What is the surprise?
The box moves.
My brother shouts: "There is a monster!"

sentences.fr: El abuelo sonríe y mira la caja.
sentences.en: Grandpa smiles and looks at the box.

sentences.fr: Yo abro la caja con cuidado.
sentences.en: I open the box carefully.
Inside there is a white rabbit.

sentences.fr: Es muy pequeño y tiene las orejas largas.
sentences.en: It is very small and has long ears.
The rabbit twitches its nose.

sentences.fr: El perro y la gata miran el conejo.
sentences.en: The dog and the cat look at the rabbit.
"He is called Carrot," says Pablo.
Mum and Dad smile.
It is a very nice surprise.

sentences.fr: Ahora nuestra familia es más grande.
sentences.en: Now our family is bigger.

quiz.why: 'Se llama Pablo y tiene cinco años.'

quiz.q_en: What is the cat Luna like?
quiz.why: 'Luna es nuestra gata. Es pequeña y negra.'
